parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive start of the window, RFC 3339. Compared against each row's hour bucket.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Exclusive end of the window, RFC 3339.

parameters.name: taskType
parameters.description: Optional exact-match filter on the task type (for example PICK, PACK, SLAM). Omit it, or send it empty, for every task type. The value is not validated: an unknown type matches no rows.

parameters.name: stationId
parameters.description: Optional exact-match filter on the station id. Omit it, or send it empty, for every station.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Bucket resolution. Only hourly buckets are modelled; any other value is a 400.
